items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Lisette was born in New York at [Sinai] Hospital... I was discharged from the hospital the day after Lisette's birthday. She was a year and a day old... they saved her birthday for me.

ctx.x: No, we were living in Englewood, New Jersey, Englewood, New Jersey. But Lisette was born in New York at [Sinai] Hospital.
So you -- after your previous experiences you must have been (inaudible) got it in for you, I should think.
